title: Open a dynamic details view when clicking Hero stats

requirements.text: Ensure that clicking the Hero stats for "10+" (Years Experience) and "1000+" (Happy Clients) opens a dynamic details view (modal/dialog) on the Home page, and that this interaction works reliably in production builds.

quotes: if i click happy clint and 10+ years experince it need to open dynamiv view

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page Hero section, clicking the "Years Experience" stat opens a modal/dialog.
Clicking the "Happy Clients" stat opens a modal/dialog.
The modal/dialog content is dynamically generated (not a static screenshot/image) and renders a scrollable list of numbers from 1 to 1000 inclusive.
The modal/dialog can be closed via an explicit close control and by dismissing the dialog (per existing dialog behavior).
No console errors occur when opening/closing the modal/dialog in a production build.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths (do not edit directly): frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose only).
Keep changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind + React Query stack.
nonGoals: Do not add new backend APIs or persist any additional data for this modal/dialog.
Do not change existing Hero section copy or add new stats beyond enabling the requested dynamic view behavior.
